## What AI Suggested

> Soften the section transitions with cross-fades; "it'll feel more polished."

---

## Why I Rejected or Revised It

> Polish flattens the rhythm I want. Hard cuts make each section assert itself; cross-fades dissolve the boundary between intents.

## What I Did Instead
